tasks.title: Define the internal YAML value tree
tasks.description: Add YamlValue with Null, Bool, Integer, Float, String, Sequence, and Mapping variants. Use IndexMap<String, YamlValue> for mappings so insertion order is preserved. Keep the type internal.

tasks.title: Implement block structure lexing and parsing
tasks.description: Parse block mappings and sequences, indentation, comments, blank lines, and multi-line plain scalars. Track byte offsets for every token. Reject tab indentation and inconsistent indentation with a positioned error.

tasks.title: Implement flow collections, quoted scalars, and block scalars
tasks.description: Parse single-line flow sequences and mappings, single- and double-quoted scalars with escapes, and literal and folded block scalars with chomping. Reject multi-line flow collections.

tasks.title: Implement YAML 1.2 core scalar resolution
tasks.description: Resolve null, tilde, true, false, decimal, hexadecimal, octal, and binary integers, and finite floats. Keep yes, no, on, and off as strings. Reject .inf, .nan, and malformed numeric literals with a positioned error.

tasks.title: Reject unsupported constructs
tasks.description: Detect and reject tags, directives, anchors, aliases, merge keys, multi-document streams, complex keys, duplicate keys, and unterminated quotes or flow collections. Every rejection carries a stable code and a position. Messages name the construct but never echo a scalar value.

tasks.title: Enforce the depth limit and trailing-content rules
tasks.description: Track nesting depth and return a positioned error above 128. Allow trailing comments and whitespace; reject any other trailing content. Keep recursion bounded.

tasks.title: Implement from_str and the serde deserializer
tasks.description: Implement from_str with a DeserializeOwned bound by walking YamlValue through a serde Deserializer. Map type mismatches to positioned errors. Empty and comment-only input resolves to null.

tasks.title: Extend yaml::Error with offset and redaction
tasks.description: Add offset to yaml::Error; implement Display as code, message, line, column, and offset, and keep std::error::Error. Ensure Debug and Display do not echo the full source or any scalar value.

tasks.title: Provide diag interop without a feature dependency
tasks.description: Document and verify that a diag Span built from error.offset renders the correct caret. Do not add diag to the yaml feature.

tasks.title: Preserve purity, feature independence, and lints
tasks.description: Keep forbid unsafe_code and deny missing_docs. Verify no default features and each feature independently. Confirm no network, filesystem, or runtime dependency is added.

tasks.title: Create the workflow shell
tasks.description: Add .github/workflows/ci.yml with push and pull_request triggers, contents read permissions, a concurrency group per workflow and ref, and cancel-in-progress enabled.

tasks.title: Add format, clippy, docs, and package jobs
tasks.description: Add jobs for cargo fmt check, cargo clippy with warnings denied, cargo doc with warnings denied, and cargo package. Install required components through the Rust toolchain action.

tasks.title: Add the OS matrix, MSRV job, and caching
tasks.description: Add stable-Rust jobs on ubuntu, windows, and macos, plus a Rust 1.85 job on ubuntu. Use Cargo caching and checkout actions. Configure each job to invoke the workspace test command; do not add or modify test files.

tasks.title: Write CONTRIBUTING.md
tasks.description: Document prerequisites, build and test commands, branch naming, commit convention, the SpecDrive proposal and apply workflow, and a pull request checklist. State that no CLA or DCO is required and contributions are MIT OR Apache-2.0.

tasks.title: Write SECURITY.md
tasks.description: Document GitHub private vulnerability reporting, supported versions, acknowledgement and triage targets, the no-public-disclosure request, and what to include in a report. Do not include a personal email unless the user supplies one.

tasks.title: Add issue and pull request templates
tasks.description: Add YAML issue forms for bug reports and feature requests, an issue template config, and a pull request template. The PR template asks for a summary, linked BP or spec, test evidence, and a checklist.

tasks.title: Add license files
tasks.description: Add LICENSE-MIT and LICENSE-APACHE with the standard texts. They must match the workspace MIT OR Apache-2.0 declaration.

tasks.title: Complete crate and workspace metadata
tasks.description: Add repository at the workspace level if inherited, and ensure the crate resolves repository, readme, keywords, categories, license, and rust-version. Add docs.rs all-features metadata.

tasks.title: Add the dado changelog
tasks.description: Create catalogue/crates/dado/CHANGELOG.md in Keep a Changelog format with a 0.1.0 entry covering the first YAML parser, diagnostics offset, and baseline release.

tasks.title: Write RELEASING.md
tasks.description: Document pre-flight checks, version and changelog, publish dry-run, tag dado-v0.1.0, the publish command, post-publish verification, and yank or rollback. Document CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN as an environment or CI secret; never include a real token.

tasks.title: Confirm package contents and publish dry-run
tasks.description: Inspect cargo package list output and confirm Cargo.toml, README.md, source files, and license files are included. Run cargo publish --dry-run and record the result in the release checklist.

tasks.title: Run the formatter check
tasks.description: Run cargo fmt --all --check and fix any formatting differences.

tasks.title: Run clippy with warnings denied
tasks.description: Run cargo clippy --workspace --all-features -- -D warnings and fix all findings.

tasks.title: Build the documentation with warnings denied
tasks.description: Run cargo doc --workspace --all-features --no-deps with RUSTDOCFLAGS set to -D warnings and fix all findings.

tasks.title: Verify packaging and governance
tasks.description: Run cargo package, cargo publish --dry-run, the governance validator, and the encoding check. Confirm the working tree is on feature/m0-foundation.

tasks.title: Perform manual content checks
tasks.description: Confirm the CI triggers and job names, issue and PR templates, license files, release runbook, and changelog entry are present and internally consistent. Do not run the test suite; that belongs to the Test agent.
